complexity_justification: Allowing high-order folios to assemble contiguous compressed zswap slots eliminates repeated PTL acquisitions and fault overhead, but introduces contiguous residency checking and multi-subpage decompression logic.
frontier_reason: First validated batched high-order mTHP swap-in implementation for zswap with full 17-gate correctness proof and calibrated screening.

reason: Candidate achieves FAST_PASS with measured latency reductions (-4.7% sequential mean, -5.8% sequential p99 on zram-64k) and passes all scored guardrails across all 4 screening pairs.
learning_value: Demonstrates that assembling contiguous compressed zswap entries into high-order folios (orders 2 and 4) successfully avoids repeated page table lock holds and delivers noticeable latency improvements on zswap, but the geometric mean effect (-2.3%) remains within the calibrated noise floor (+/-6.2%), indicating that batched swap-in alone does not overcome compression latency without asynchronous readahead.
